steps.eval: (() => [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href], button, summary, input')].map(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(el); return { tag: el.tagName, cls: (el.className || '') + '', txt: (el.textContent || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().slice(0, 16), w: Math.round(r.width), h: Math.round(r.height), fs: cs.fontSize, disp: cs.display }; }).filter(o => o.disp !== 'none' && (o.w < 24 || o.h < 24)))()
